status: registered_design; instrumented clinical inference not implemented or queued yet
authorization: User prefers useful evidence-strengthening work before considering claim narrowing.
existing_outcomes_seen: Two-seed manuscript and 120-cell paired audit. Post-result mechanism investigation, not outcome-blind confirmation.
dependency: All 15 terminal models and complete learned/drop/renormalized-drop/keep-one grids, all lanes and the activated fold-4 reassignment must finish and pass artifact validation.
checkpoint: terminal/latest, epoch 99; content hashes frozen before inference
validation_membership: All original validation studies in saved folds; patient ID removes final hyphen component; seeds reuse the same studies.
primary_endpoint: Per-region study-mean Dice over positive-reference studies, equal WT/TC/ET mean; summarize folds equally. All-case/empty-region sensitivity separate.
primary_runtime: Original frozen evaluator: bfloat16 inputs and CUDA bfloat16 autocast, batch size 4, unchanged preprocessing and mask thresholds. Record actual instrumented dtypes.

hypotheses.finite_epsilon: Surviving-mixture variance/epsilon and scale predict paired post-IN differences under the ideal shared-tensor relation.
hypotheses.numerical_precision: Weight renormalization, products and accumulation may violate pre-IN proportionality; quantify before attributing differences to epsilon.
hypotheses.downstream_response: Subsequent selectors, nonlinearities and decision margins may amplify measured stage discrepancies. Mechanisms can coexist.

measurements: Study/patient/fold/base and effective seed/stage/branch/checkpoint hash/runtime dtype
Pre-edit channel weights, surviving mass, actual floored denominator and post-edit weights; zero/floor counts
Per-channel spatial variance using actual normalization convention, epsilon and scale
Pre-IN residual z_renorm minus t*z_drop, absolute and relative; flag zero-norm cases
Paired post-IN/pre-activation discrepancies and finite-epsilon identity residuals
Downstream selector changes, logits, near-threshold margins, region mask disagreement and paired Dice effects
local_reference_replay: Replay identical captured branch tensors/pre-edit weights in float64 separately from native-runtime tensors. Use biased spatial variance. Local epsilon sweep 0, 1e-8, 1e-5, 1e-3 does not modify clinical checkpoints; zero epsilon/zero variance is undefined and reported.

precision_sensitivity.selection: First two unique patients per fold ordered by SHA256('kernel_normalization_audit_v1:' + patient_id); every validation study of these patients, all seeds and stage/branch edits. Freeze IDs before inference.
precision_sensitivity.comparison: Full float32 inference without autocast, float32 inputs/weights, TF32 disabled and recorded, versus primary bfloat16 inference on identical selected studies.
precision_sensitivity.boundary: Local float64 replay isolates arithmetic on fixed representations; full float32 also changes upstream representations. Exploratory sensitivity, not cohort-level accuracy comparison.

engineering_gate: Validate config, epoch, checkpoint content, splits and completed CSV hashes
CPU probes for mass above/below floor, zero mass, constant mixtures and epsilon-zero domain
Compare instrumented and uninstrumented primary-runtime outputs on deterministic subset; measure repeated-forward noise before fixing empirical numerical tolerances
Reproduce stored primary-runtime paired Dice; unexplained differences block full mechanism reporting
Check selected-stage upstream tensors and pre-edit weights agree across paired runs; record deviations rather than assume exact proportionality
analysis: All 180 branch cells and 45 seed/fold/stage groups. Retain hierarchical study/channel identifiers; no channel-count inflation of sample size. Report winner agreement and effect magnitude, descriptive variance/scale/arithmetic/downstream relationships. No positive or significant result required.
resources: Inference only after the full matrix gate; inspect CPU/I/O/GPU before launch, one worker per free GPU, streaming summaries instead of full-cohort tensor dumps.
outputs: results/kernel_normalization_audit_v1/ with distinct attempts, source/code/environment hashes, fidelity report, per-study/channel summaries and scientific report
claim_policy: Retain manuscript while gathering evidence; decide interpretation after diagnostics without guaranteeing present wording under every outcome.
